reason: The missing receipts at month end are a real headache, but I don't touch receipts, my bookkeeper does, and I'm not moving my site crews onto some new Telegram bot that might be gone next year. At most I forward the link to my bookkeeper and forget about it.
objection: Will this little bot still be running in a year? If I get thirty guys sending receipts to it and it shuts down or changes, I've made a mess for my bookkeeper and I'm back where I started.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper trying it on one site for a month and telling me it actually cut the missing documents, and that everything stays in my own Google sheet if the bot disappears.
